name: Janardhan Polle
headline: Full Stack Developer · AI/ML Tooling
summary: Full-stack developer who ships production-grade AI developer tooling, including an open-source MCP server with 3,000+ GitHub stars in active use across the AI coding-assistant ecosystem. Comfortable across the stack (Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Python) and increasingly focused on the intersection of web engineering and applied AI/ML: agent memory systems, LLM fine-tuning, and Model Context Protocol tooling. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and quick to pick up new stacks to ship real, used software.
strengths: Ships open-source tools people actually adopt (3k+ GitHub stars)
Fluent across TypeScript, Rust, Python, and Go
Fast, self-directed learner; adapts to new stacks quickly

experience.title: Application Developer
highlights: Developed complex, data-dense grid UIs with filtering, sorting, inline editing, and undo/redo, plus other niche features required for effective data management in a web application.

experience.title: Full Stack Development Intern
highlights: Developed and deployed multiple web applications end-to-end, focusing on full-stack development with Next.js, Node.js, and related web technologies.

projects.name: Shadcn UI MCP Server
highlights: Built a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server giving AI coding assistants comprehensive programmatic access to shadcn/ui v4 components, demos, blocks, and metadata across React, Svelte 5, Vue, and React Native.
Engineered real-time component source retrieval, intelligent GitHub API caching with rate-limit handling, SSE transport for multi-client deployments, and Docker-based production deployment.
Published as an open-source npm CLI (npx-installable) with a one-click .mcpb installer for Claude Desktop; now used widely enough to rank among the most-starred MCP servers in its category.

projects.name: PolygenS Melody Generation Platform
highlights: Developed a React/Next.js frontend with interactive Piano Roll and Note Grid interfaces for real-time musical parameter editing.
Engineered a high-performance TypeScript backend on Elysia/Bun for orchestration and API management, with OAuth/JWT auth and Google Cloud Storage integration via pre-signed URLs.

projects.name: db-manager
highlights: Built a Rust-based terminal UI tool that orchestrates database containers via Docker, letting developers create, manage, and connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis instances from a single interface.

projects.name: spamfilter
highlights: Probabilistic (Naive Bayes) email spam classifier written in Go.
